notes.title: Hotfix Ver 1.0.6 H2
notes.content:
Customer Support

Some users are experiencing an issue where, after selecting a mission, the camera points to the sky, and the game does not progress.
- This issue cannot be reproduced in the current development/QA environment or on the reported devices, making it difficult to resolve.
- Based on the YouTube video you reported, we investigated game performance using the Unity Performance Profiler and identified performance-intensive effects on the CPU/GPU. These have been disabled under the ZA001 option.
- For users experiencing this issue, please go to Settings -> Controls, turn ZA001 to ON, and proceed with the game.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused while using the game.
Thank you.

notes.title: Hotfix Ver 1.0.6
notes.content: Fixed an issue where some buildings appeared and disappeared intermittently in the newly applied camera perspective.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
Game Quality Upgrade
- Default game camera perspective reconfigured.
- Adjusted the camera perspective that caused dizziness for many users.

New Features
- Added camera change functionality.
- Use C on the keyboard or press the right stick on the gamepad to switch.
You can choose between a new camera perspective, the old version of the camera perspective, or a zoom-in camera perspective.

Thank you.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
Improved Controls
- Adjusted the logic for assisting with targeting nearby units.
- Fixed an issue where units would attack in an unintended direction, differing from the user’s intent.

Bug Fixes
- Resolved an issue where players would sometimes be KO'd despite energy remaining in the health UI.

Thank you

notes.title: Ver 1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
New Features
- Added faster dialogue functionality using a keyboard or gamepad.

Game Stabilization
- Unity engine upgraded from 6.0.27f1 to 6.0.32f1.

Customer Support
- Issue where some users experienced the camera pointing to the sky after mission selection, preventing further gameplay.
- This issue has not been reproducible in the current development/QA environment, nor on the reported devices, making it difficult to fix.
- Assuming the issue might be related to the Unity engine, we upgraded it to the latest version.

Thank you.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3 H1
notes.content:
Customer Service

Some users are experiencing an issue where, after starting a mission, the camera shows the sky, and no further progress can be made.

- This issue has not been reproducible in the current development/QA environment, making it difficult to address.
- Based on the bug video you provided, we have added safety and bypass codes to the potentially problematic logic.
- If the issue persists in this version, we apologize, but could you provide the CPU, memory, and OS information of the affected computer to help us fix the bug?

Thank you.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Graphics Optimization
- Added an option to adjust female unit quality.
- Added an option to adjust street quality.

New Features
- Added an option to invert the camera Y-axis.

Customer Support
- Fixed an issue where some users experienced the screen switching to the sky after the tutorial, preventing further gameplay.
- Go to Settings -> Controls -> Turn ZA001 to ON.
- As this issue could not be reproduced in the development environment, debugging is challenging. The suspect logic believed to cause this bug is disabled with the above option.

Thank you.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Hotfix

notes.title: Ver 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
A. Graphics Optimization
Added the ability to change male unit quality.
- Male units created with fewer polygons and simpler textures have been separately designed and prepared.
- When male unit quality is changed in the settings, these optimized units will appear.

B. Game Guide Added
Added guidance for cases where the game lags or slows down.
- Provides solutions for issues when the game slows down during the first startup.
- Offers countermeasures for game slowdown caused by resolution changes due to game engine issues.
